overview: Three years after climbing Mount Madyopuro, Andrew and his friends reunite when an occult ritual threatens his family and draws them to Mount Klawih.
tagline: Three years later, the reunion turns into a rescue mission. Welcome to Mount Klawih.
title: Five Friends 2: Mount Klawih
